text:
maya: opened a PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8421 that tightens the SA token projection scope for the on-prem sidecar and touches one logging line that currently includes tenant_id. planning to merge Fri 10:00 PT unless sec/privacy blocks. need quick sec/privacy review — should we redact tenant_id in logs or mask it?

liam: looks small from the diff, can you paste the sample log line here so we can see what we'd be removing/masking?

maya: sure, sample log line:
```
[2026-03-16 12:23:45] INFO auth: issued token for tenant=tenant-123456 user=svc-ingest trace=abc123
```
thinking either remove `tenant=...` entirely or replace with `tenant=redacted` or `tenant_hash=ae3f` (sha256 prefix). which is preferable?

jess: prefer removing tenant id from service logs. if teams require mappings, provide an audit-only sink (rotating, access-controlled) or store mapping in audited vault. hashing is ok only if we salt centrally and control mapping. also run the log-scan script in CI to make sure no other lines leak tenant ids :eyes:

rahul: from privacy POV redact. tenant identifiers can be sensitive depending on customer contracts — treat as identifiers and avoid plain-text in logs.

maya: ok will implement redaction by default. quick question: is it acceptable to add an env flag `LOG_MASK_TENANT=true` in onprem config so customers can opt-in to the old behavior during migration? default should be true for new installs.

zoe: SGTM for default=true but add a clear migration note in the release docs for Dedicated/Private customers and warn about support window.

liam: small CI update — one flaky test failed, unrelated to this change. i can push a fix in a separate commit and re-run CI.

devops-bot: ci/circleci — build passed (after rerun)

security-bot: quick scan of IAM and SA surface: changes look minimal. approve once logs are redacted. :white_check_mark:

maya: i'll push the redaction change + update PR description with the migration note and CC the customer success owners. will ping here when done. planning to merge Fri 10:00 PT if no further blockers. thanks all :pray:
